    empty_bins = np.isclose(bins, max_cap)
    
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -inf if 'inf' in globals() else -float('inf'), dtype=float)
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores

    tightness = 1.0 / (remaining + 1e-7)

    normal_valid = valid & (~empty_bins)

    valid_empty = valid & empty_bins

        min_normal_tightness = np.min(tightness[normal_valid]) if np.any(normal_valid) else 10.0
        scores[valid_empty] = min_normal_tightness * 0.5
        
    return scores
